modules.title: Geolocation-Aware Trending Carousel
modules.subHeading: Delivering a personalized car shopping experience through data-driven UI.
modules.description: A smart car discovery carousel that adapts to the user's physical location.
keyFeatures: Integrated with a Geolocation API to display trending Toyota models specific to the user’s current city.
Features a custom 'Focus-Scale' effect where active items enlarge dynamically as they reach the middle position using Splide.js.
Real-time price and technical specification updates based on the active selection.

modules.title: Optimized Test Drive Lead Generation
modules.subHeading: Converting interest into action with a streamlined booking interface.
modules.description: A conversion-focused form designed to capture user information for test drive scheduling.
keyFeatures: Intelligent alert system that notifies users if a specific model is available for test drive in their area.
A clean, multi-step inquiry form capturing full name, contact details, and purchase timelines.
Fully responsive design built with Tailwind CSS to ensure brand consistency across all devices.

modules.title: API-Driven Dynamic Form Architecture
modules.subHeading: A scalable solution for complex, ever-changing data requirements.
modules.description: A highly flexible form engine that renders UI components based on dynamic backend values.
keyFeatures: Developed a dynamic rendering engine in Next.js that builds the UI based on JSON schema returned from the API.
Manages complex dependencies, such as cascading filters for Province, City, and Sales ID in real-time.
Allows for instant form updates (adding/removing fields like Tenor or Branch) without requiring new code deployments.
